```{r}
#| include: true
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "setup.R"))
```

# Modelos de predicción de movimiento sísmico

## Corteza superficial activa (ASC)

{{< include /_chapters/gmm.ASC.es.md >}}

::: {.content-hidden when-format='docx'}
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (!is.null(GMPETable) && nrow(GMPETable[TRT == "ASC"])) {
  Mw.target <- if (!exists("Mw.gmm", inherits = FALSE)) 6.5 else if (is.null(names(Mw.gmm))) Mw.gmm[[1L]] else if ("ASC" %in% names(Mw.gmm)) Mw.gmm[["ASC"]] else 6.5
  NGR::knitBlock(path = "/_fig/GMPE.ES.qmd", stem = "gmm-asc-att", labels = "rewrite", vars = list(ID.target = unique(GMPETable[TRT == "ASC", ID]), Mw.target = Mw.target, fillColor = unname(.TrtColors[["ASC"]])), root = root)
  rm(Mw.target)
}
```
:::
